title: Directed mixed membership stochastic blockmodel
abstract: arXiv:2101.02307v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mixed membership modeling for undirected networks has been extensively explored in network science over the past few years. Despite the substantial progress made for undirected cases, handling mixed membership structures in directed networks continues to pose substantial difficulties. To address this gap, we introduce the Directed Mixed Membership Stochastic Blockmodel (DiMMSB), a novel framework tailored for directed networks with overlapping communities. A key feature of DiMMSB is its ability to treat the row and column nodes of the adjacency matrix as distinct entities, each potentially following its own community organization. Building on this model, we develop DiSP, an efficient spectral procedure to estimate mixed memberships for both sets of nodes. translated_title: 有向混合隶属度随机块模型
translated_abstract: 过去几年中，无向网络的混合隶属度建模在网络科学领域得到了广泛探索。尽管无向网络的研究已取得重大进展，但处理有向网络中的混合隶属度结构仍然面临巨大困难。为填补这一空白，我们提出了有向混合隶属度随机块模型，这是一个专为具有重叠社区的有向网络量身定制的新框架。DiMMSB的一个关键特性是能够将邻接矩阵的行节点和列节点视为不同的实体，每个实体都可能遵循各自的社区组织结构。基于该模型，我们开发了DiSP，一种高效的谱方法程序，用于估计两组节点的混合隶属度。通过细致的分析，我们在温和的稀疏性条件下推导出了DiSP的节点级误差界。仿真结果支持了理论结果，表明……
tldr: 本文提出有向混合隶属度随机块模型及配套的高效谱估计算法DiSP，能够分别刻画有向网络中行、列节点的重叠社区归属，并在温和稀疏条件下给出节点级理论误差保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Directed Mixed Membership Stochastic Blockmodel (DiMMSB) and an efficient spectral estimation procedure DiSP, which captures the overlapping community memberships of row and column nodes separately in directed networks with node-specific theoretical error guarantees under mild sparsity conditions.
